title.en: Chapter 8 — At Midnight in the Graveyard

sentences.en: At night, Tom and Huck went to the graveyard.

sentences.ar: خبوا حالهم ورا شجرة وهم خايفين.
sentences.en: They hid behind a tree, afraid.

sentences.ar: كانوا الدكتور روبنسون، وماف بوتر، وجو.
sentences.en: They were Doctor Robinson, Muff Potter, and Joe.
A quarrel broke out between them over money.

sentences.ar: جو طعن الدكتور وحط السكينة بإيد ماف.
sentences.en: Joe stabbed the doctor and put the knife in Muff’s hand.

sentences.ar: ماف كان سكران وما فهم إشي.
sentences.en: Muff was drunk and understood nothing.
